matched_summary.metric: Pre2019 mean fold Spearman, not classification accuracy

limitations.deletion: Every single and double column removal occurs only after the entire unchanged X input design is prepared. Remaining columns keep their original fold-specific order; no feature selector is rerun. Width falls to46/45, so deletion differences also include model dimension/representation effects and do not isolate causal information.
limitations.permutation: Each one column is independently permuted within role, draft cohort and its exact own missingness mask. Width47 and all other values/order stay fixed. Three prespecified permutation seeds; stream fifty:registered_input:<column>. Controls may break algebra/correlation with other fields and are exploratory usability diagnostics, not significance tests.
limitations.comparison: Report deletion-minus-full and permutation-minus-full by seed/fold; full-minus-permutation as a separate fixed-width diagnostic. Do not pool permutation seeds as independent observations. No automatic promotion.

raw_output_location: tasks/*.json; initial records remain in the frozen reference artifact
phase: R9a input deletion and permutation diagnostics
